I'm going to speak at DevAI by Data Science Summit on the 19th of October!

My talk: "Harness Engineering - Principles and Practices"

Expect a honest look at hype vs. reality and a practical path from “vibe coding” to a disciplined, auditable, high-velocity engineering machine.

The session is available as Online VoD - so you can watch at your own pace.

Register here: https://devai.dssconf.pl
